existing_contracts.promise: Unmix plan channels of a YXC/ZYXC field, other planes untouched; repeated advanced-assignment channels are not independent physical coordinates.
Explicit channel indices identify ordered last-axis physical channels; no supplied selection means all channels.
Plan spans the actual measured settings channels, records matching matrix/provenance.
Preview/batch same ordered channels and controls; no alteration of source arrays, real double-stain/PSF/registration gaps remain open.

proposed_scope: Normalize explicit selectors in _prepare_unmixing before any control loads.

_prepare_measure_unmixing passes original selectors rather than int truncation; no matrix/control/algorithm/rank changes.
